plan.title: Docs: strong skill pack ("skill bundle") documentation — dedicated page, CLI reference, fork runbook, developer guide
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Documentation-only change over ten files. The projected-surface lint counts each top-level doc file as its own subsystem (features/skill-packs.mdx, features/skills.mdx, docs.json, CHANGELOG.md, docs/USAGE.md, ...), so one documentation surface reads as ten subsystems. The issue defines the page, CLI reference, developer guide and small edits as one cross-linked set; split sibling issues would ship pages that link to pages that do not exist yet.

narratives.Problem: All skill pack documentation is appended per pack inside features/skills.mdx (lines 282-748): no overview, quickstart, catalog, consolidated trust model, fork runbook, troubleshooting, pan skills CLI reference, or developer guide to src/lib/skill-packs and src/lib/skill-overrides.
narratives.Proposal: Create features/skill-packs.mdx with ten fixed sections and move every pack section into it (cut, never copy, verified by a mechanical fact-preservation check against base commit 312f4f2c496), leaving a short stub in features/skills.mdx. Add cli/skills-commands.mdx from the branch --help output, docs/SKILL-PACKS.md verified by git grep, a pointer in reference/template-conversations.mdx, links from docs/USAGE.md and the codebase map, and a CHANGELOG.md Unreleased entry. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4759.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to skill pack behavior, CLI flags, adapters, or the dashboard (the only source edit is the stale comment at src/cli/commands/skills.ts:9)
- No new lint script or test for links or fact preservation; the PRD section 8 commands are run by hand and by review
- No edit to changelog.mdx, CLAUDE.md, features/conversations.mdx, or docs.json redirects
- No fork sync, upstream fetch, gh repo sync, or pack add/remove/gc run on the host for this issue
- No contact of any kind with upstream repositories (garrytan/*, mattpocock/*, cursor/*, deftai/*, sageox/*)
- No screenshots or images
- No build of the pan bundle proposal (PAN-1357)
- No documentation of the hidden pan skills launch-settings command on the CLI page

autoDecisions.summary: Move the whole ## Deft Directive H2 (lines 639-748) into ## Packs as ### Deft Directive and merge the ### Deft stub into it.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue lists Deft among per-pack sections and its 470-line count includes this H2; keeping the heading text keeps the #deft-directive anchor.

autoDecisions.summary: Correct the line-307 known-pack sentence during the move (gstack has a default url; only pstack has a default ref).
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified in skills.ts:321-331 and KNOWN_PACKS; the issue forbids invented behavior, so a wrong sentence is fixed and listed as intentional rewrite R1.

autoDecisions.summary: Document hidden pan skills launch-settings only in docs/SKILL-PACKS.md.
autoDecisions.rationale: It is registered with { hidden: true } and is a launcher-internal step.

autoDecisions.summary: Use npx tsx src/cli/index.ts skills ... --help from the workspace as the flag oracle.
autoDecisions.rationale: The workspace has no dist/; tsx help was verified to print the branch's commands.

autoDecisions.summary: Leave changelog.mdx, features/conversations.mdx and the CLAUDE.md topic index unchanged.
autoDecisions.rationale: changelog.mdx is release-owned; the conversations link targets on/off levels that stay in features/skills.mdx; the issue names the exact small edits.

autoDecisions.summary: Use a fixed H2 '## Packs' wrapper with one H3 per pack so the page has exactly ten H2 sections.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's structure has ten sections with per-pack sections as one of them; existing H3/H4 nesting moves without relevelling except Deft.

autoDecisions.summary: No per-row anchor links in the catalog table.
autoDecisions.rationale: The slug of a heading with an apostrophe cannot be verified without a Mintlify build.
